purpose: Concrete governed KPI definitions that can be sourced from current SYNTH-V2 native immutable snapshots without inventing external ERP/WMS fields.

kpis.businessDefinition: Actual landed cost of the exact immutable order commit represented by one landed-cost snapshot.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Landed-cost snapshots with exact order-commit lineage; for close-grade reporting supplyLineageComplete must be true.
kpis.aggregationRule: Use one governed current/effective landed-cost snapshot per order commit. Sum across distinct order commits only after currency/perimeter normalization; never sum historical versions of the same commit.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: Landed cost must be positive by domain invariant; missing snapshot is MISSING; stale ledger lineage is INVALID.
kpis.reconciliationControl: TotalLandedCost must equal the signed sum of the exact costEntryIds included in the landed-cost snapshot.

kpis.businessDefinition: Committed order net revenue less actual landed cost on the exact same order-commit lineage.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Margin actualization snapshots linked to the same order commit and landed-cost snapshot.
kpis.aggregationRule: Amounts are additive across distinct order commits in the same currency/perimeter. Never add multiple actualization versions for one order commit.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: Negative margin amount is a valid VALUE; missing revenue or landed-cost basis is MISSING; lineage mismatch is INVALID.
kpis.reconciliationControl: ContributionMarginAmount = NetRevenue - LandedCost exactly at MONEY_SCALE.

kpis.businessDefinition: Actual contribution margin amount divided by committed net revenue for the same immutable order commit.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Margin actualization snapshots with positive governed NetRevenue and exact landed-cost lineage.
kpis.aggregationRule: SUM(ContributionMarginAmount) / SUM(NetRevenue) at target perimeter. Never AVG source contributionMarginPercent values.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: NetRevenue <= 0 is INVALID for this ratio contract; negative numerator is a valid negative ratio; missing basis is MISSING.
kpis.scaleContract: Canonical KPI storage is decimal ratio. Current domain contributionMarginPercent is percentage-points scale because calculateMoneyPercentage multiplies by 100. Do not ingest it directly as the canonical value.
kpis.reconciliationControl: CanonicalRatio ~= ContributionMarginPercentSource / 100 within approved rounding tolerance.

kpis.canonicalName: SKU Actual Landed Cost per Unit
kpis.businessDefinition: Allocated actual landed cost per committed unit for a SKU using one immutable cost-allocation run.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: SKU economics rows from an actual allocation run with positive committed quantity.
kpis.aggregationRule: SUM(SkuAllocatedLandedCost) / SUM(SkuQuantity); never AVG SKU unit costs when quantities differ.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: Quantity must be positive by domain invariant; missing allocation run is MISSING; stale landed-cost basis is INVALID.

kpis.businessDefinition: Control ratio proving that the complete allocated amount equals the landed-cost basis of the run.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Actual cost-allocation runs and the exact linked landed-cost snapshot.
kpis.aggregationRule: Evaluate at run grain; expected value is exactly 1 after governed rounding. Do not average across failed runs to hide exceptions.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: TotalLandedCost must be positive; zero/missing basis is INVALID or MISSING according to lineage state.
kpis.targetBandSemantics: Expected 1.000000 within explicitly approved rounding tolerance; domain and database already reject material mismatch.

kpis.businessDefinition: Signed share of a selected actual cost component in total landed cost for one governed perimeter.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Landed-cost component totals on the same exact landed-cost snapshot.
kpis.aggregationRule: SUM signed component amount / SUM landed cost at target perimeter. Recompute for each costType; do not average order-level percentages.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: TotalLandedCost must be positive; negative component share is valid for credits/corrections; missing component means zero only when absence is proven complete, otherwise MISSING.

kpis.businessDefinition: Share of the four mandatory cost-close requirement types that are no longer pending at one readiness evaluation.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Exactly factory, freight, duty and credits requirements from one readiness snapshot.
kpis.aggregationRule: COUNT(requirement status in complete,waived) / 4 at snapshot grain. Do not average across repeated readiness snapshots for the same order commit.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: All four requirement types must exist exactly once; missing/duplicate requirement is INVALID, never silently treated as pending or zero.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicyDetails: Numerator is a true subset of the four required types. Waived is resolved for blocking readiness but is not evidence-complete.

kpis.businessDefinition: Share of mandatory cost-close requirements resolved by waiver instead of evidence-backed completion.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Exactly factory, freight, duty and credits requirements from one readiness snapshot.
kpis.aggregationRule: COUNT(status=waived) / 4; portfolio rollup should be SUM waived requirements / SUM required requirements on one selected snapshot per order commit.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: All four requirement types must exist. Waived without waiverReason is INVALID by domain rule.

kpis.businessDefinition: Share of physically received units accepted after damage and rejection disposition.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Governed receipt lines on immutable receipt snapshots.
kpis.aggregationRule: SUM(AcceptedQuantity) / SUM(ReceivedQuantity). Never AVG line acceptance percentages.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: ReceivedQuantity is positive on persisted receipt lines; AcceptedQuantity must be between 0 and ReceivedQuantity; any violation is INVALID.

kpis.businessDefinition: Share of physically received units recorded as damaged.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Governed receipt lines with positive physically received quantity.

kpis.businessDefinition: Share of physically received units rejected at receipt.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Governed receipt lines with positive physically received quantity.

kpis.businessDefinition: Final confirmed shortage quantity as a share of shipped quantity after the receipt sequence is finalized.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Only finalized discrepancy snapshots; select one latest finalized snapshot per shipment notice.
kpis.aggregationRule: SUM(ShortageQuantity) / SUM(ShippedQuantity) over the latest finalized discrepancy per shipment; never include interim snapshots repeatedly.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: Non-finalized discrepancy is NOT_APPLICABLE for shortage; shipped quantity must be positive; shortage must be 0..shipped quantity.

kpis.businessDefinition: Confirmed quantity received above shipped quantity, expressed relative to shipped quantity.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: One governed latest discrepancy snapshot per shipment for the reporting cut.
kpis.aggregationRule: SUM(OverageQuantity) / SUM(ShippedQuantity); not a TRUE_SUBSET_SHARE because overage can in principle exceed shipped quantity.
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: ShippedQuantity must be positive; negative overage is INVALID; ratio may exceed 1 and must not be silently capped.

kpis.businessDefinition: Share of shipment notices whose contractual/native expected-delivery deadline falls in the reporting cohort and whose final receipt was recorded no later than that deadline.
kpis.eligiblePopulation: Shipment notices with expectedDeliveryAt in the due cohort. Open overdue shipments remain in the denominator; do not restrict denominator to completed receipts.
kpis.aggregationRule: COUNT(DISTINCT shipment with final receipt receivedAt <= expectedDeliveryAt) / COUNT(DISTINCT shipment due in period).
kpis.zeroNullErrorPolicy: No shipments due is N/A. Missing final receipt after due date is a valid failure, not MISSING. Missing shipment deadline is INVALID.
kpis.antiGamingControl: Denominator is the due cohort and includes open overdue shipments, preventing closed-only survivorship bias.
